Now I see the bug. In the `partial_data && (needs_decrypt || needs_decompress)` case, `_zip_source_window_new` is called with `src` as the lower source. But `_zip_source_window_new` does NOT take ownership of `src` (it calls `zip_source_keep(src)` internally). So the caller still owns `src`. However, the code doesn't free `src` after creating the window source. This means when the window source is later freed, it will free its reference to `src`, but the caller's reference is leaked...
